working_definition: Largest gut group (4715 cells): epithelial cells of the crop, the foregut food-storage sac (Li et al. 2022; author term FBbt:00003133 crop; broad class epithelial cell).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Cell of the epithelium lining the adult crop. These cells are of ectodermal origin and produce the cuticular lining of the crop system (Stoffolano Jr and Haselton, 2013).

justification: Authors' term is the organ; the cell-level equivalent (adult, epithelial class per the authors) is epithelial cell of crop.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Pedunculate sac evaginating from the adult foregut just before it meets the midgut; stores ingested liquid food.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Organ term, not a cell term.
